failureFirst.fail: **凍結 hold-out では 0.1% に入らない。残差 +2.65% は刻みを細かくしても消えない。** ①dt 0.016→0.008→0.004 で +2.83%→+2.69%→+2.65% と**ほぼ平ら**なので、これは離散化ではなく処方そのものの限界である。②内訳は**第252便a で同定し直した**: 近点移動を Δϖ≈A0+λ·A_PN と分けると、実測は **A0+A_PN/2 = 0.0000568+0.0020193 = 0.0020761°/周** と 5 桁一致する。つまり残差の実体は **A0(λ_PN=0 の非 1PN 基線・観測の +2.81%)** であって、半分処方は 1PN チャネルしか触らないのでこれを消せない(λ_PN=1/f 候補でも同じ)。**旧記述の「処方の +1.26% + 凍結の代価 +1.4%」は誤った分解である** — 凍結 κ(12.0154)と本系の閉形式解(12.0086)の差は 0.06% しかない。③**A0 が何で決まるかは未解決**: kFrame=0 にすると消え(引きずりチャネル)・D0pull の 2 乗で効く(×0.5 で 0.25 倍・×2 で 4.0 倍)が、**等質量度(|m₁−m₂|/M を 0〜0.1 に振っても ±7%)・coupleSink・cmGauge・softening のいずれでも説明できない**(第252便a §EQ/§DIAG)。④作用原理・保存則は未導出でエネルギーは閉じない。⑤半長径はケプラー派生値・質量は二重条件つきである。
failureFirst.pass: **この系を 1 度も見ずに決めた 1 個の κ で、近点移動が観測の 2.025 倍から 1.027 倍へ入る。** 🧶 の宣言を 1 か所も動かさず compactForce を 1 行足すだけで、+0.0040959°/周(観測の +102.5%)が **+0.0020761°/周(+2.65%)** になる。**κ は ⚡ で凍結した数そのままで、本系での再 fit も再評価もしていない** — 凍結 hold-out として手続きが成立している。合わせていない周期は −0.064% で 🧶 と同水準を保つ(追加項が軌道の大きさをほとんど動かさないことの再確認)。そして**残差 +2.65% の内訳が量的に説明できる**ことが、次に何を測るべきかを 1 行で指している: 第252便a の分解では実測が **A0+A_PN/2 と 5 桁一致**し、残差の実体は **A0(λ_PN=0 の非 1PN 基線)**である — **A0 が何で決まるのか**が次の問いである。

descStruct.summary: **🧶 を複製して、⚡ で凍結した κ をそのまま宣言した第 4 の凍結 hold-out**(第251便a — 第43報 W1)。式もゲートも 🪝🪄🩹 と同一の **U_K=−κ·χ₁χ₂·(G m₁m₂/ρ)·(v₁·v₂)/c²** で(引きずり A8/E6′ と測地線1PN E12 は 🧶 の宣言のまま)、**この系を見て決めた係数は 1 つも無い**(κ=12.015360249506628 は ⚡ の値・f は一次則の 1 回評価)。開発集合 3 本が −0.02〜−0.14% に入るのに対し、本系の残差は **+2.65%** で、しかも刻みを細かくしても消えない。その内訳は第252便a で **Δϖ=A0+A_PN/2**(実測と 5 桁一致)と同定され、残差の実体が **A0(λ_PN=0 の非 1PN 基線)**であることまで分かっているので、**「合わない」ではなく「何がどれだけ足りないか」が数で言える**状態になっている。
descStruct.control: ワンタップ対照A/B: B側 **compactForce なし** — +0.0040959°/周(2.025 倍)へ戻る。**🪝🪄🩹(開発集合 3 本)と本サンプル(凍結 hold-out)を並べて見る**のが本サンプルの使い方 — 同じ 1 個の κ で残差が −0.020% / −0.040% / −0.143% / **+2.65%** になり、開発集合と hold-out の差がそのまま見える。timeScale=1000 で1公転が実時間 約3.6秒・dispMag=1000(表示専用)。

failureFirst.fail: THE FROZEN HOLD-OUT DOES NOT REACH 0.1%, AND THE +2.65% RESIDUAL DOES NOT GO AWAY WITH A FINER STEP. (1) Over dt 0.016→0.008→0.004 the residual is +2.83%→+2.69%→+2.65%, essentially FLAT: this is a limit of the prescription, not of the discretization. (2) THE BREAKDOWN WAS REDONE IN WAVE 252a: writing the advance as A0 + lambda*A_PN, the measurement equals A0 + A_PN/2 = 0.0000568 + 0.0020193 = 0.0020761°/orbit to five digits. The residual therefore IS A0 — the lambdaPN=0, non-1PN baseline, +2.81% of the observation — which a halving prescription cannot touch because it only scales the 1PN channel (the lambdaPN=1/f candidate is no different). THE EARLIER BREAKDOWN ('+1.26% from the prescription plus +1.4% as the price of freezing') WAS WRONG: the frozen kappa (12.0154) differs from this system's own closed form (12.0086) by only 0.06%. (3) WHAT SETS A0 IS UNSOLVED: it vanishes at kFrame=0 (so it is the dragging channel) and scales as D0pull squared (x0.5 gives 0.25, x2 gives 4.0), but NEITHER the degree of mass equality (sweeping |m1-m2|/M from 0 to 0.1 moves it by only 7%) NOR coupleSink, cmGauge or the softening accounts for it (wave 252a, sections EQ and DIAG). (4) No action principle, no conservation law, energy does not close. (5) The semi-major axis is Kepler-derived and the masses are doubly conditional.
failureFirst.pass: ONE NUMBER, FIXED WITHOUT EVER LOOKING AT THIS SYSTEM, BRINGS THE ADVANCE FROM 2.025x THE OBSERVATION TO 1.027x. Without moving any of 🧶's declarations, one added line takes +0.0040959°/orbit (+102.5%) to +0.0020761°/orbit (+2.65%). THE kappa IS ⚡'S FROZEN NUMBER, neither re-fitted nor re-evaluated here, so the hold-out procedure is intact. The unfitted period stays at 🧶's level (−0.064%), reconfirming that the added term barely moves the size of the orbit. AND THE +2.65% RESIDUAL IS QUANTITATIVELY ACCOUNTED FOR: wave 252a's decomposition reproduces the measurement as A0 + A_PN/2 to five digits, so the residual IS A0 — the lambdaPN=0, non-1PN baseline — which points in one line at what to measure next: WHAT SETS A0.

descStruct.summary: 🧶 COPIED, WITH ⚡'S FROZEN kappa DECLARED UNCHANGED — THE FOURTH FROZEN HOLD-OUT (wave 251a, report 43 W1). Formula and gate are 🪝🪄🩹's: U_K = −kappa·chi₁chi₂·(G m₁m₂/rho)·(v₁·v₂)/c². NO COEFFICIENT WAS CHOSEN BY LOOKING AT THIS SYSTEM (kappa is ⚡'s number; f is the linear law evaluated once). Where the three development systems land at −0.02 to −0.14%, this one lands at +2.65%, and refining the step does not remove it. Because the breakdown is identified — wave 252a reproduces the measurement as A0 + A_PN/2 to five digits, so the residual IS A0, the lambdaPN=0 non-1PN baseline — the state of affairs is not 'it disagrees' but 'here is exactly how much is missing and why'.
descStruct.observe: Measured over a five-periastron window: PERIASTRON ADVANCE +0.0020761°/orbit at dt=0.004 = +2.65% of the converted observation 0.0020225°/orbit. Over dt 0.016→0.008→0.004 it is +0.0020798→+0.0020769→+0.0020761 (+2.83%→+2.69%→+2.65%), essentially FLAT, so the residual is not of discretization origin. Removing compactForce gives +0.0040959°/orbit (+102.5%). The unfitted periastron-to-periastron period is 36328.48 s (−0.064% of 36351.7026 s; 36306.10 s = −0.125% at the default step). The breakdown, redone in wave 252a: A0 + A_PN/2 = 0.0000568 + 0.0020193 = 0.0020761°/orbit matches the measurement to five digits, so the residual IS A0 (the lambdaPN=0 non-1PN baseline, +2.81% of the observation); the frozen kappa 12.0154 differs from this system's own closed form 12.0086 by only 0.06%. Zero NaN, zero clamps, run-time chi=0.99949. Periods are judged only after their definition has been declared (adjudication I6).
descStruct.control: One-tap A/B: side B has NO compactForce and the advance returns to +0.0040959°/orbit (2.025x). THE INTENDED USE IS TO PUT THE THREE DEVELOPMENT SYSTEMS (🪝🪄🩹) BESIDE THIS FROZEN HOLD-OUT: under one and the same kappa the residuals read −0.020% / −0.040% / −0.143% / +2.65%, and the gap between a development set and a hold-out is visible directly. With timeScale=1000 one orbit takes ~3.6 wall seconds; dispMag=1000 (display only).
descStruct.brief: Carry the frozen κ over to B1534. Partial: the comparison runs are in the ledger. Calibration: hold — apsidal advance +2.94% (5.8×10³σ); numerics unresolved.

failureFirst.fail: **4 例目でも近点移動は約 2 倍で、しかも比が 3 例と 1.3% 違う。** ①実測 +0.0040959°/周 は観測の +102.5% で、これは較正質量 f≈2 が E12 の 1PN チャネルへ入る第248便b の構造そのままである。②比が 2.025 であって 2.000 ではない原因は**第252便a で同定した**: Δϖ≈A0+λ·A_PN と分けると A_PN/観測=1.997 で 3 例と同じで、余分の全部が **A0(λ_PN=0 の非 1PN 基線)=+0.0000568°/周=観測の +2.81%** である(dt 0.004/0.001 で不変=離散化ではない)。**「ちょうど半分を打ち消す」型の処方(κ でも λ_PN=1/f でも)は 1PN チャネルしか触らないので A0 はそのまま残る**(旧記述の「+1.26% を残す」は比を丸ごと半分にした誤り — 正しくは A0+A_PN/2)。③合わせていない周期は −0.064%・離心率は +0.138% で、⚡🧮🩺(周期 0.01〜0.03%)より 1 桁悪い。④質量は GR 由来の条件つき値からさらに一次則で較正した二重条件つきである。⑤半長径はケプラー派生値である。
failureFirst.pass: **⚡ の処方を 1 か所も変えずに、係数を 1 つも決めずに、周期と離心率が 0.1% 台で乗る。** 一次則を本系で 1 回評価しただけの f=1.9994855 を入れ、kFrame=1・pull 重み・D0pull=3.24204e-7 の宣言を ⚡ と同一にすると、合わせていない近点間周期は 36328.38 秒(観測の −0.064%)・離心率 0.274054(転写の +0.138%)。**近点移動が観測の約 2 倍になる構造が 4 例目でも再現する**ことが、第248便b の同定(較正質量 fM が 1PN へ入る)が系に依らない構造であることの追加証拠になる。

descStruct.summary: **予告(第284便b・原仮定者の裁定(第74報)⑤): この本は旧則(質量補正 f≈2 の条件つき較正)のままである。⚡ は f=1(観測質量)へ移った。本系も f=1 署名の便で移行する —— 以下の f≈2 に基づく判定と近点移動の比は旧則の履歴で、「質量を補正して周期に合わせる」処方を現行の根拠にはしない。** **📿(観測版)と同じ幾何・同じ観測入力の上で、計算式だけ kFrame=1 の DFM 側へ差し替えた版**(第251便a — 第 4 の凍結 hold-out)。⚡ の処方(kFrame=1 の引きずり A8/E6′+測地線1PN E12・pull 重み・D0pull=3.24204e-7・coupleSink:"core"・cmGauge・framePrecision:"double")をそのまま当て、質量は一次則 f=1+k_F(αχ_A+βχ_B) を**本系で 1 回評価**した f=1.9994855(fit ノブなし)。**この系を見て決めた係数は 1 つも無い**。見どころは「近点移動が観測の約 2 倍になる」構造が 4 例目でも出るか、そして**その比が 3 例の 2.000 と同じか**である — 実測は **2.025** で、1.3% だけ違う。

failureFirst.fail: THE ADVANCE IS AGAIN ABOUT TWICE THE OBSERVATION — AND THE RATIO DIFFERS FROM THE OTHER THREE BY 1.3%. (1) The measured +0.0040959°/orbit is +102.5% of the observation, exactly the wave-248b structure of the calibrated mass f≈2 entering E12's 1PN channel. (2) WHY THE RATIO IS 2.025 AND NOT 2.000 WAS IDENTIFIED IN WAVE 252a: splitting the advance as A0 + lambda*A_PN gives A_PN/obs = 1.997, the same as the three development systems, and ALL of the excess is A0 — the lambdaPN=0, non-1PN baseline, +0.0000568°/orbit = +2.81% of the observation, unchanged between dt=0.004 and dt=0.001 (so it is not discretization). ANY 'CANCEL EXACTLY HALF' PRESCRIPTION (kappa or lambdaPN=1/f) ONLY TOUCHES THE 1PN CHANNEL, SO A0 SURVIVES IT (the earlier wording '+1.26% remains' halved the whole ratio and was wrong; the correct value is A0 + A_PN/2). (3) The unfitted period (−0.064%) and eccentricity (+0.138%) are an order of magnitude worse than on ⚡🧮🩺 (0.01–0.03% in period). (4) The masses are doubly conditional: a linear-law calibration on top of GR-derived values. (5) The semi-major axis is Kepler-derived.
failureFirst.pass: ⚡'S RECIPE, UNCHANGED, WITH NO COEFFICIENT DETERMINED HERE, STILL LANDS THE PERIOD AND ECCENTRICITY AT THE 0.1% LEVEL. With f=1.9994855 (the linear law evaluated once on this system) and ⚡'s declarations (kFrame=1, pull weights, D0pull=3.24204e-7), the unfitted periastron-to-periastron period is 36328.38 s (−0.064%) and the eccentricity 0.274054 (+0.138%). THAT THE FACTOR-OF-TWO STRUCTURE REAPPEARS ON A FOURTH BINARY is additional evidence that the wave-248b identification (the calibrated mass fM entering the 1PN channel) is a structural property, not a per-system accident.

descStruct.summary: NOTICE (wave 284b, the adjudicator's ruling, 74th report ⑤): THIS BUILD STILL RUNS THE OLD RULE (the conditional f≈2 mass correction). ⚡ has moved to f=1 (the observed masses) and this system will move in its own f=1 signature wave — the f≈2-based verdicts and apsidal-advance ratios below are the old rule's history, and the recipe of correcting the masses to match the period is not a current basis. THE SAME GEOMETRY AND THE SAME OBSERVED INPUTS AS 📿, WITH ONLY THE FORMULA SWITCHED TO THE kFrame=1 DFM SIDE (wave 251a — the fourth frozen hold-out). ⚡'s recipe is applied unchanged (pull weights, D0pull=3.24204e-7, coupleSink:"core", cmGauge, framePrecision:"double"), and the masses come from the linear law f=1+k_F(αχ_A+βχ_B) EVALUATED ONCE on this system: f=1.9994855, no fitted knob. NO COEFFICIENT WAS CHOSEN BY LOOKING AT THIS SYSTEM. What to watch is whether the 'advance is about twice the observation' structure reappears on a fourth binary and whether THE RATIO MATCHES the 2.000 of the other three — measured, it is 2.025, off by 1.3%.
descStruct.observe: Measured over a five-periastron window at dt=0.004: PERIASTRON ADVANCE +0.0040959°/orbit = +102.5% of the converted observation 0.0020225°/orbit, i.e. a ratio of 2.025. At the default dt=0.016 it is +0.0041003 (+102.7%). The unfitted side: periastron-to-periastron period 36328.38 s (−0.064% of 36351.7026 s; 36306.00 s = −0.126% at the default step) and measured eccentricity 0.274054 (+0.138%). Zero NaN, zero clamps. THAT THE RATIO IS 2.025 RATHER THAN 2.000 is the central measurement of this sample, and wave 252a's decomposition shows THE WHOLE DIFFERENCE IS A0 (the lambdaPN=0 baseline, +0.0000568°/orbit = +2.81% of the observation, unchanged from dt=0.004 to dt=0.001). Periods are judged only after their definition has been declared (adjudication I6).
